prs.title: Editorial: title mapping for abbr element - Remove not applicable statement
prs.author: spectranaut
prs.body:
🚀 **Netlify Preview**:
🔄 **this PR updates the following specs**:
- [html-aam preview](https://deploy-preview-2927--wai-aria.netlify.app/html-aam/index.html) — [html-aam diff](https://services.w3.org/htmldiff?doc1=https%3A%2F%2Fw3c.github.io%2Fhtml-aam%2F&doc2=https%3A%2F%2Fdeploy-preview-2927--wai-aria.netlify.app%2Fhtml-aam%2Findex.html)

This doesn't close the issue https://github.com/w3c/html-aam/issues/246 because it doesn't describe the mapping of `title` on an `abbr` which I suppose is the whole point of this element -- but at least we can remove this nonsensical line?
